name: gpm-main-graph-benchmark
description: gpm-main-graph-benchmark evaluates graph-learning models on core graph tasks such as node/graph classification, link prediction, and graph matching across standardized datasets and splits. It is intended to measure structural understanding and generalization of graph neural networks and related methods. The benchmark provides consistent evaluation protocols to compare model performance on a variety of graph types.
reputation: A specialized dataset from DataSeer for graph learning research with limited mainstream visibility but relevance to graph ML researchers.
